module.name: Opacity
module.purpose: Defines opacity as a substrate-level condition where a system becomes partially or fully non-observable due to mismatch between substrate, operators, harmonic envelope, or flow. Provides operators, diagnostics, lineage, examples, and integration rules.

modules_linked: substrate → operators → harmonic envelope → flow → boundary → diagnostics → examples → integration

submodules.purpose: Defines all 14 opacity operators and their interaction rules.

submodules.name: Examples
submodules.purpose: Multi-scale examples demonstrating substrate, operator, harmonic, flow, and boundary opacity.

submodules.name: Integration
submodules.purpose: Cross-module integration rules for SARG, Corpus, NIST, and RTT/1.
